title: Justice Dept. Subpoenas Times Freelancer in Effort to Identify Sources
summary_full: A previously undisclosed subpoena, involving reporting on a failed SEAL Team 6 mission in North Korea, reflects the government’s expanding campaign to investigate leaks of secrets.
